question: To achieve its target of becoming net carbon zero by 2035, Reliance Industries plans to replace transportation fuels with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**clean electricity and hydrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Reliance Industries aims to achieve net carbon zero by 2035 through the adoption of clean energy sources.
 
• The company plans to replace traditional transportation fuels with clean electricity and hydrogen to reduce carbon emissions.
 
• Hydrogen is being considered a key element because of its potential to significantly lower greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• Clean electricity, generated from renewable sources like solar and wind, will play a crucial role in powering transportation systems.
 
• This strategic shift aligns with global trends towards sustainable and renewable energy solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrogen as a Fuel**

 
 
• Hydrogen fuel cells generate electricity through a chemical reaction between hydrogen and oxygen, with water being the only byproduct.
 
• Hydrogen can be produced using renewable energy sources, making it a sustainable option.
 
• It offers high energy density and can be used in various transportation modes, including cars, buses, and trains.
 
 
 
• **Clean Electricity**
 
 
• Clean electricity is derived from renewable resources such as solar, wind, hydro, and geothermal energy.
 
• It helps reduce reliance on fossil fuels and cuts down greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• Advancements in technology are making renewable energy sources more efficient and cost-effective.
 
 
 
• **Global Energy Transition**
 
 
• Countries around the world are increasingly committing to net-zero carbon targets to combat climate change.
 
• The transition involves significant investment in renewable energy infrastructure and technology.
 
• International agreements like the Paris Agreement are driving the push towards sustainable energy solutions.
 
 
 
• **Reliance's Green Energy Initiatives**
 
 
• Reliance Industries has announced several green energy projects, including the development of the Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex in Jamnagar, Gujarat.
 
• The company is investing in solar panel manufacturing, battery storage, and green hydrogen production.
 
• These initiatives are part of a broader strategy to diversify its energy portfolio and reduce carbon footprint.
